notes.title: Version 2.2.0.7 Hotfix
notes.content: [p]A small but significant update has been published![/p][list][*][p]Fixed crashing on some systems[/p][/*][*][p]Made all assets sans code open and easy to modify[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 2.2.0.4
notes.content:
I promised a major update earlier this year, here it is!

[h2]Changelog[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added Turkish translation
[*] Crosshair can now be turned off
[*] Improved AI death animations
[*] Added vertex colouring to all levels
[*] Fixed glitch where the left hand was showing at all times
[*] Fixed glitch where locked missions appeared when you select an unlocked one
[*] Fixed various texture issues
[*] Fixed all of the glitches that occur when you turn the pause animation off.
[*] Fixed Z-fighting on level 6
[*] Fixed collision issues on level 10
[*] Added city skyboxes to urban levels
[*] McIain now hides before you climb the ladder
[*] Helicopter boss now emits projectile particles when shooting
[*] Added Unlimited FPS option
[*] Fixed various easter eggs
[*] Updated dialogue on last level to comply with updated lore
[/list]

notes.title: New update is on it's way
notes.content:
I've gone through the game with a professional QA tester for a couple of hours and I have a big list of bugs to squish and QoL changes to implement. I'm going to through all of them and release a big update. This will take a while, so I figured I'd let everyone know that fixes are coming!

Thanks for your patience!

notes.title: Operation: Pinkeye - Version 2.0 Release Notes
notes.content:

[list]
[*]Updated and improved articles
[*]Fixed glitches with some strings
[*]Updated briefs to better fit the story and lore
[*]Fixed glitch where some posters and shelves didn't have any backs
[*]Fixed clipping problem on level 6
[*]Maxwell has now been stripped of weapons on level 7 and needs to regain them
[*]Turrets now take breaks
[*]Fixed problem where ammo depeletes when switching weapons too quickly
[*]Fixed mission failed glitch on level 8
[*]Fixed problem with shooting after quickload
[*]Fixed problem where bookcase doesn't open
[*]Sorted out door placements on level 3
[*]Fixed glitch that stopped the final boss from showing
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.4
notes.content:
I planned for a bigger update, but it seems my playtester has gone AWOL, so my ability to track down and squish bugs was limited

[list]
[*]Fixed collisions on army base
[*]Fixed camera destroy objectives not being beatable after quickload
[*]Fixed problem with Sergio McIain glitching on quickload
[*]Fixed issue with McIain being too easy on level 4

[/list]
This is likely my last update for 2022, so let me wish everyone a Merry Christmas, Happy Hannukah, Happy Kwanza, or whatever winter holiday you celebrate!

-Cobra!

notes.title: Version 1.38 Hotfix
notes.content:
A quick update because I realised some of the issues I fixed ended up breaking other things. I've fixed them now, so hopefully all is well!

[list]
[*]Fixed some more level mesh & texture issues
[*]Fixed weapon changing problems
[*]Fixed problems with aimin and shooting after reloading
[*]Fixed problems with the final boss

[/list]
Still waiting for my new playtester to get back to me...

-Cobra!

notes.title: Update 1.35
notes.content:
Another quick update fixing some more bugs. Thought I'd release it as I wait for my new playtester to come back with a report. It's kind of just sitting there otherwise.

[list]
[*] Fixed some level mesh issues
[*] Added indicator to tell you you have a disguise on
[*] Added a menu after you die
[*] Fixed Out of Bopunds glitches with levels 3 and 4
[*] Added a park to level 6
[*] Fixed framerate issues
[/list]
If you guys experience any more bugs, please let me know and I will get to them as soon as possible.

-Cobra!

notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.content:
Another big update to the game that hopes to fix many of the bugs present in the game as well as QOL changes.

[list]
[*] Fixed problems with collision with AI from a distance
[*] Fixed clipping issues with level meshes
[*] Added a light to cameras to make them easier to spot
[*] Shooting at doors no longer show floating bullet hole
[*] Props now darken as they get damaged
[*] Bullet trails from guns now follow the resulting bullet holes
[*] Fixed achievements and added 2 more
[*] Fixed bug with not being able to shoot in aim mode while at a wall
[*] Fixed issue with 2 music tracks playing at the same time on quickload
[*] Final boss winds up gun to give the player warning and can now be locked on
[*] Fixed bug with getting into the main room in level 13 early
[*] Added key rebinding menu
[*] Switching gadgets now shows the name like with weapons
[/list]

Still a few more bugs to fix, but I'll hopefully get them fixed before Christmas!

-Cobra!

notes.content:
Another series of fixes, just for you!

[list]

[*]Added extra text at credits

[*]Updated Russian Translation
[*]Fixed tracker icon to match model
[*]Fixed spot on level 2 where you can get stuck
[*]Fixed seams problems on levels 2, 12, 13 and 14
[*]Fixed level 6 ceiling texturing
[*]Fixed problem with gun animation showing upon death

Some people are requesting some QOL changes. Don't worry, I'm working on them next. I'm just getting all of the glaring bugs out of the way first.

notes.title: Operation: Pinkeye - Version 1.1 Release
notes.content:
Whew! I managed to fix most of the reported bugs, and hopefully people should have a much smoother time playing the game now!

Changelog:
[list]
[*] Quicksaves fixed
[*] Level 4 boss fixed
[*] Unpausing now shows the second gun on dual wield
[*] Cheats.txt window sized properly
[*] Weapons now only hide when directly at a wall, and not when facing away
[*] Fixed glitches with aiming while sprinting
[*] Fixed out of bounds glitch on level 6
[*] Clicking X now exits articles
[*] Article typos fixed
[*] Added finished French and Russian translations
[*] Final boss secret weapon now picking up properly
[*] Doors now aligned properly
[*] Shooting a boss before dialogue no longer cancels it
[*] Train external now shows at the end of level
[*] Tracker looks more like a tracker now
[*] Horizontal aim improved
[/list]

I apologise to those who had a rough experience with the initial release version, I hope this is an improvement!

notes.title: Softlock FIxed
notes.content:
Just a quick update to announce an emergency patch to fix a mission softlock on the second to last level where the final door wouldn't unlock.

I've also fixed a couple of other issues as I've been working on the 1.1 build:
[list]
[*]Fixed some door misalignment on some levels
[*]Fixed issue with the first level not letting you shoot through open doors
[*]Fixed problems with aim mode when sprinting
[*]Fixed the issue with weapon hiding at wall even when facing away from it
[*]Improved horizontal aiming sensitivity
[*]Added collision back to boat stairs on level 2
[/list]

Thanks to everyone here for reporting these bugs!

notes.title: Operation: Pinkeye is now available!
notes.content:
[b]The game is now available to buy after 4 years in development![/b]

I would like to take this oppurtunity to thank each and everyone who has supported me throughout it all!

[list]
[*] The composers for their amazing music!
[*]The sound director for their well done SFX!
[*]The actors for showing me the ropes and showing me how directing is usually done!
[*]E1M1 an Reload magazines for making my dream of having the game reported in a magazine and put on a physical demo disc come true!
[*]and all of my friends who have supported me through it all and helped spread the word!
[/list]

Hopefully it was all worth it, and I hope everybody enjoys it!
